key_points: Headlines are dominated by ETF flow and 'Buffett stock' listicles — noise with no fundamental read-through.
Japan ¥/$1.1B bond sale at higher rates is a marginal negative on funding costs, but tiny relative to Berkshire's balance sheet and cash position.
BNSF Q3 +19.3% earnings lift is supportive but already reflected after the report and record-high share price.
GEICO Florida-related job cuts are a small operational adjustment, not thesis-relevant.
Defensive rotation into Berkshire amid a market shock (Nvidia CEO exit) supports relative performance but is sentiment-driven, not a change in intrinsic value.
